name: personal_admin_manager
description: Personal admin manager for calendar, todo tasks, reminders, and email. Use this for multi-step personal operations that may span these categories in one run.

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: supporting context (names, dates, URLs, prior results) or ''

arguments_prompt:
Arguments to personal_admin_manager are:
- task: required detailed instructions for calendar/todo/reminder/email operations.
- information: optional supporting context and constraints.

metadata.planner_description: Email, calendar, todo, and reminders — multi-step personal-admin work, especially when it mixes those categories.
